# Riza Jenkins (D)

# Chair

![](/media/uploads/2025/12/jenkins.jpg)

- Member of **[Democratic Women of Orange County](https://rizajenkins.com/about-riza)**
- In the **[private sector](https://www.energync.org/crew/riza-jenkins-chair/)** Jenkins is the former chair of the NC Sustainable Energy Association’s (NCSEA) Equity, Diversity, and Inclusion board. The NCSEA **[encourages](https://www.energync.org/about-us-2/equity/)** “dialogue about race and gender among clean energy advocates to support diversity efforts.” The NCSEA “has made an intentional effort to recruit a diverse workforce.”
- Jenkins is an advocate of the Marxist BLM organization:
